mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) relative to the previous quarter indicates strong consumer spending, which drives corporate earnings growth and positive equity valuations, leading to higher S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS growth exceeds 0.5% MoM, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 0.5% for three consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary policy that reduces liquidity and increases discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 0.5% for 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in real personal consumption (RSAFS) and decline in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a demand surge outpacing supply capacity, leading to inflationary pressures and reduced corporate profit margins, which causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS rises and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), the tight labor market fuels wage growth and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above its 12-month moving average indicates accelerating inflation, which typically leads to central bank tightening and negative equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL rises above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 for two consecutive months, it signals a weakening manufacturing sector that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 105.0 for 2 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong labor market growth (PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM) and low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 0.5%) indicates an accommodative environment that fuels inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in an imminent rate hike.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 0.5% MoM and FEDFUNDS < 0.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high housing starts (HOUST > 1200.0 thousand units), the housing sector's strong performance boosts consumer confidence and spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1200.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.
